content.title: Lighthouse Light Activation | Lantern Trigger, Orb Scale and Eye Return
content.summary: An adult signal keeper raises one lamp and receives a cyan reservoir-light response. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult warrior, blade and field persist. + One red accent family carries every activation stage. + The gaze change precedes forward action. + Exactly one principal sword cut occurs. + The final stance is readable without inventing casualties or victory.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult signal keeper above a stormy reservoir holding one amber inspection lamp. When he raises the amber lamp once, release six cyan signal orbs from the waterline. Push to one eye and place a single cyan reflection in the iris, preserving his face and warm lamp spill.
required_anchors: One clearly adult keeper, lantern and cliff persist.
The gesture visibly triggers the accent light.
Warm and cool anchors never swap roles.
The final eye detail is causally linked to the same light family.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult signal keeper raises one lamp and receives a cyan reservoir-light response. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.rule: The gesture visibly triggers the accent light.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The gesture visibly triggers the accent light."

invariants.rule: Orb count scales in bounded stages.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Orb count scales in bounded stages."

invariants.rule: Warm and cool anchors never swap roles.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Warm and cool anchors never swap roles."

invariants.rule: The final eye detail is causally linked to the same light family.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final eye detail is causally linked to the same light family."
